title: Usage examples

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Show the relationship rule in realistic layouts, because a correct explanation must remain readable alongside schedules, speakers and other sponsors.
strategic_value: Secondary IBM placements tied to specific roles can keep event communication clear about who contributes what.
demonstration: Three laptop mockups show an event schedule with dinner sponsorship, an IBM speaker listing and a row of multiple sponsors.
practical_value: Choose a placement next to the relevant contribution rather than using a generic masthead endorsement.
